newsitem.title: UK: $1.0 trillion raised in international mkts in H1.
newsitem.headline: $1.0 trillion raised in international mkts in H1.

text.p: Over $1.0 trillion was raised in the international bonds, equities and loans markets in the first six months of 1997, a new record, the International Financing Review (IFR) said on Monday.
Emerging market sovereign and corporate issuers from Latin America, Asia and eastern Europe contributed nearly $433 billion, a new record, it said.

"The impending arrival of European Monetary Union produced a new high yield European bond market with expectations this will develop into a major new market in Europe similar to the US junk bond market," it said.
It said global mergers and acquisitions contributed to a boom in the syndicated loan market.
International equity capital markets were driven by a combination of privatisation activity, jumbo block trades and in Asia a wave of activity in Hong Kong around the handover to China.
